test_profiler_profile: test the xformers.profiler.profile context manager for profiling PyTorch modules with custom schedules
test_profiler_step: test the xformers.profiler.step function for advancing profiler steps within a profiling context
test_profiler_overhead: test the xformers.profiler.profile function to verify it adds no hooks or dispatch mode overhead on compiled modules
test_analyze_prof_flops: test the assert_flops context manager and profile_analyzer to verify forward and backward pass FLOP counts
test_analyze_prof_sdpa: test SDPA attention FLOP analysis across efficient attention, flash attention, and cudnn attention backends
